blockingFindings.finding: The learned package does not currently contain an approved, source-independent ONE PIECE signature whose allowed role and scope include a host team post detail. The only portable approved rule, editorial-module-rhythm, is useful information architecture but is not distinctive enough by itself to move the current generic archive treatment beyond the reported 70% state.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Collect and interpret rendered source evidence for one or more post-compatible, content-independent signatures (for example a verified metadata marker, bounded section framing system, or typographic pairing) and explicitly approve their host editorial/detail roles before Design Direction is reopened.
